Trigger.Name: KEY-LISTVAL
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
NEW DECSUB CLASS
DESCRIPTION: GET RECORD,BLOCK,ITEM PROPERTY
PROGRAMMER :
VERSION : 1,
DATE : 27/02/2005 
*/

DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(100) := 'GROUP_LOV';
 RET NUMBER;
 V_DISP_LOV BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
 IF :SYSTEM.MODE <> 'ENTER-QUERY' THEN
 IF Get_Record_Property(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK,STATUS) IN ('NEW', 'INSERT') THEN
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, INSERT_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, ENABLED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, UPDATE_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
ELSE
 IF GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK, QUERY_ALLOWED) = 'TRUE' THEN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM, QUERYABLE) = 'TRUE' THEN
 V_DISP_LOV := TRUE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;
 Go_Block('calling_parameters');
 go_item('p_from');
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name, 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_TITLE', TEXT_PARAMETER, 'قائمة بارقام المجموعة ');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_WIDTH', TEXT_PARAMETER,5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_X_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, 1.5);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'WINDOW_Y_POS', TEXT_PARAMETER, .8);
 CALL_FORM('LOV_GROUP.fmx',NO_HIDE,NO_REPLACE,QUERY_ONLY,pl_id);
 IF :GLOBAL.GROUP_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
 :p_from := :GLOBAL.GROUP_ID;
 :G_ANAME_FROM := :GLOBAL.G_ANAME;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 END IF;

 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5); 
BEGIN 
 -- SELECT count(1) into v_count FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
 SELECT count(1) into v_count 
 FROM
 SC_USER_GROUPS
 WHERE GROUP_ID IN (:P_FROM,:P_TO)
 OR :P_FROM IS NULL;

 IF v_count > 0 then 
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_FROM',TEXT_PARAMETER, :P_FROM);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_TO',TEXT_PARAMETER, :P_TO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_G_ANAME_TO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:G_ANAME_TO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_G_ANAME_FROM',TEXT_PARAMETER, :G_ANAME_FROM);
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 END ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: LOAD_LIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE LOAD_LIST IS
 V_RG_ID RECORDGROUP;
 
BEGIN
 V_RG_ID := FIND_GROUP('GROUP_TYPE');
 IF ID_NULL (V_RG_ID) THEN
 V_RG_ID := CREATE_GROUP_FROM_QUERY ('GROUP_TYPE', 'SELECT RV_MEANING,TO_CHAR (RV_LOW_VALUE)
 FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''STATUS''');
 END IF;
 IF POPULATE_GROUP (V_RG_ID) = 0 THEN
 POPULATE_LIST ('P_STATUS',V_RG_ID);
 END IF;
END;
